lines.text: Have you ever tried to hold your whole life together?
Open your Bible with me, to the book of Romans, chapter twelve, verse one.
I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice,
holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
Now let's talk about surrender. A lot of people think surrender means you lost.
It doesn't. Surrender is putting the keys in the right hands. And those are the hands of God.
So today, give Him the plans you've been carrying. Give Him the habits you keep saying you want to break.
You don't need anything special for this. Right where you are is enough.
If you truly want to give it to God, and you're tired of carrying the keys yourself, pray with me.
God, I surrender my life to You. You can have it all, every thought, action, behavior, and desire.
I want You to be glorified through me. So here I am, Lord. Take me, use me, send me, change me, clean me, transform me, love me, and love others through me.
Take all that I am, and use it for Your glory. In Jesus' name, amen.
If you prayed that with me, the keys are in His hands now. Have a blessed day.
